info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Correspondent Bank Directory Validation API
info.description: The Correspondent Bank Directory Validation API enables businesses to validate the details of correspondent banks within their banking operations. This endpoint allows users to submit specific parameters to check the accuracy and reliability of bank directory information. It is typically utilized by financial institutions, compliance teams, and payment processors to ensure regulatory adherence and operational efficiency. By using this API, organizations enhance data integrity and facilitate smoother banking transactions.

post.summary: Validate Correspondent Bank for a given external agency.
post.description: This endpoint validates the details of a correspondent bank associated with a specific external agency identified by RES-100045. It checks the provided information and confirms whether it meets the necessary criteria for valid operations.
